note: No referee used the scale terms, so all four levels are inferred. R1 is a borderline call: the positive tone suggests minor, but the requests for new Hall data, a DFT band structure and crystallographic tables are substantial new data, so major revision was chosen. R3's first-round report was an attachment at the end of the file; it asks for full-Brillouin-zone, anharmonic and AIMD calculations. 'Cannot be considered' is conditional on revision, so this is major revision, not reject. The second attached 'Report on NCOMMS-25-71045' is a round-2 report and was excluded. The file shows no transfer from another journal and no co-signed reports. All four referees recommended publication in round 2.
